detail.longDescription: I really missed writing code by hand. Getting stuck on problems and not having the answer be 1 prompt away. I'm automating some things at my farm so this gave me the perfect escape from my AI heavy job. I've also been wanting to play with Zig for a long time. I used it for writing this broker and also doing baremetal STM32 with it. I can't remember the last time I had this much fun programming. Thought I share with some of you HN folks
